nomenclature_note: The current accepted identity is Eidophelus formosanus (Browne, 1981), VSN_2547. Beaver & Liu (2010) publishes the name as Ernoporus formosanus (Browne) and records a new combination; the source-published combination is retained at evidence level while the current canonical identity remains Eidophelus formosanus.
